entities.name: Hans Zdražila
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hans Zdražila is a retired Czechoslovak weightlifter who won a gold medal at the 1964 Summer Olympics setting a world record in the 75 kg weight category. By the next Games he moved to the heavier 82.5 kg division and finished sixth. At the world championships he won two bronze medals, in 1963 and 1966.
